current_metrics.index_family_caveat: Cross-market spread mixes inflation-compensation regimes: leg_a references 'EU_HICP' while leg_b references 'UK_RPI', so this spread captures BOTH inflation-expectation differentials AND structural index-family differences — it is NOT a clean expected-inflation divergence.
current_metrics.methodology_label:
Same-tenor cross-market zero-coupon inflation swap (ZCIS) spread
between two ZCIS curve families at the same pillar (e.g.
USD_ZCIS 5Y minus EUR_ZCIS 5Y, USD_ZCIS 10Y minus GBP_ZCIS 10Y,
EUR_ZCIS 5Y minus GBP_ZCIS 5Y).  Computed per-trade-date via
the SPREAD formula:

  spread_pct = leg_a_pct - leg_b_pct
  spread_bps = spread_pct * 100

where ``leg_a_pct`` and ``leg_b_pct`` are the ZCIS rate levels
at ``tenor`` on ``leg_a_curve_family`` and ``leg_b_curve_family``
respectively (each computed by
``calculate_inflation_swap_rate_level`` filtered by
``instrument_type='inflation_swap'`` AND
``pricing_type='zero_coupon_breakeven'`` AND
``curve_family=?`` AND ``tenor=?`` — the no-proxy guard
inherited transitively).  The two endpoint series are aligned
per-trade-date via a strict pandas inner-join on calendar
trade_date AFTER each is computed independently; the spread
is computed only on dates where BOTH legs exist (no synthetic
spread points are produced).

INDEX-FAMILY CAVEAT (load-bearing): USD_ZCIS, EUR_ZCIS, and
GBP_ZCIS reference different inflation indices (US CPI-U /
Eurozone HICP-xT / UK RPI), so this spread captures BOTH
inflation-expectation differentials AND structural index-family
differences; it is not a clean expected-inflation divergence.
Each leg's ``inflation_index_family`` / ``index_lag`` /
``interpolation`` / ``underlying_index`` is surfaced on the
wire (per-leg) so the desk reader can decompose the spread
under the correct ZCIS conventions without a second tool call.

Sign convention: spread = leg_a - leg_b.  The LEFT leg
(``leg_a_curve_family``) is the numerator and the RIGHT leg
(``leg_b_curve_family``) is the denominator, so the spread
sign is predictable from the input ordering.  Same-curve,
two-tenor spreads (e.g. USD_ZCIS 5Y vs USD_ZCIS 10Y) are NOT
accepted by this primitive — the schema layer rejects
``leg_a_curve_family == leg_b_curve_family`` so cross-market
semantics cannot be silently inverted to a curve spread.
Same-curve curve spreads belong to
``inflation_swap_curve_spread``.

time_series_spread.description: Same-tenor cross-market ZCIS spread for EUR_ZCIS vs GBP_ZCIS at 5Y ((leg_a_pct - leg_b_pct) * 100) over the displayed window.  INDEX-FAMILY CAVEAT: leg_a references 'EU_HICP' while leg_b references 'UK_RPI' — this spread captures BOTH inflation-expectation differentials AND structural index-family differences; it is NOT a clean expected-inflation divergence.

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the EUR_ZCIS-GBP_ZCIS cross-market ZCIS spread (in bps) at 5Y vs its own trailing window.
